operation.description:
Use this API to batch ship packages by providing multiple package IDs. This API is available for TikTok shipping orders as well as seller shipping orders. 

- `TikTok Shipping`: Schedule a package handover time for TikTok Shipping carriers to pickup a package from the Seller. 
- `Seller Shipping`: Seller arranges their own shipping, and upload a `tracking_number` and `shipping_provider_id`. Package ID can be obtained from [Get Order Detail](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa8ccc16ffe02b8f167a0?external_id=650aa8ccc16ffe02b8f167a0).

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

packages.description: Input list of packages you would like to batch ship.

handover_method.description:
Possible values:
- `PICKUP`: A shipping provider will pickup the package(s) from the seller's pickup address.
- `DROP_OFF`: The seller will need to drop off the package(s) at a designated location.

end_time.description: The end date and time of the package pickup time slot. Unix timestamp.

start_time.description: The start date and time of the package pickup time slot. Unix timestamp.

self_shipment.description: Only needed for seller shipping packages. Check the `delivery_option `field in [Get Package Detail](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa39fbace3e02b75d8617?external_id=650aa39fbace3e02b75d8617) to see how to differentiate between TikTok shipping and seller shipping. Use the `shipping_provider_id` retrieved from the [Get Shipping Providers](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa48d4a0bb702c06d85cd?external_id=650aa48d4a0bb702c06d85cd#Back%20To%20Top) API and upload the corresponding tracking number.

shipping_provider_id.description: For packages with the `SEND_BY_SELLER` delivery option type (seller shipping), you must provide the shipping provider information. Please use the [Get Shipping Providers](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/650aa48d4a0bb702c06d85cd?external_id=650aa48d4a0bb702c06d85cd#Back%20To%20Top) API to obtain the `shipping_provider_id`.

tracking_number.description: For packages with the `SEND_BY_SELLER` delivery option type (seller shipping), you must provide the package's tracking number.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

errors.description: Return list of possible errors during package batch shipment attempt.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
